description: Galnewa Pradeshiya Sabha - Roads and Streets owned by the Galnewa Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content deals specifically with land and property-related matters, namely the declaration of roads and streets as owned by the Galnewa Pradeshiya Sabha. It includes detailed schedules of road coordinates, dimensions, and construction types, and provides a legal process for land ownership objections. This falls squarely under the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) as it concerns property ownership declarations and land administration matters.
